dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards a slender posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Margins are largely smooth and continuous with no significant localized bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-level light-grey shading across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Extremely low density; faint, diffuse grey shading visible on the posterior third of the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Very diffuse gradient between the mature white baseline and the subtle posterior grey shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct cluster of bright, linear white marks (rake-like or linear scarring) on the right lateral-dorsal margin; two small, high-contrast white circular spots located near the base of the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear white scarring on the mid-right flank and circular depigmented spots on the lower peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Centrally positioned, high-contrast circular blowhole visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
